question: Should Nameplate officially maintain a Linuxbrew formula in `steipete/homebrew-tap`, including automated updates and documented GTK4/desktop-session requirements?
rationale: This is technically feasible with existing release artifacts, but accepting it commits the project to another supported installation and upgrade channel whose dependency and lifecycle policy belongs to the repository owner.

options.title: Support Linuxbrew
options.body: Add and maintain a two-architecture formula in the existing tap, with automated release updates and explicit runtime caveats.

options.title: Keep tarball distribution
options.body: Continue publishing Linux tarballs only and clarify the manual installation and update workflow in the Linux documentation.

recommendation.title: Support Linuxbrew
recommendation.body: Add and maintain a two-architecture formula in the existing tap, with automated release updates and explicit runtime caveats.

likelyOwner.reason: The choice affects release policy across the Nameplate repository and steipete-owned Homebrew tap.
